extmetadata.ImageDescription:
Don Moye with Art Ensemble of Chicago at the stage of Energimølla. The concert was part of Kongsberg Jazzfestival and took place on 07. July 2017.
Lineup: Roscoe Mitchell (saxophone), Hugh Ragin (trumpet), Jaribu Shahid (double bass), Don Moye (drums)
